# Every test file under .github/scripts, fork-ci and fork-kit (*.test.*, subdirectories included) and
# where it runs (.github/scripts/fork-ci-tests.cjs checks this list).
#   <test>                  run by Fork tests (fork-kit/ in the kit job, fork-ci/ and the
#                           fleet walls' in the action job, the rest in the workflows job),
#                           by extension (sh, py, cjs, mjs, js)
#   <test> ~<seconds>s      the same, with its usual time on CI: the longest start first,
#                           and a part split into shards (FORK_CI_TEST_SHARD) is split by
#                           them. Tests without one start first and count as 10 s. A test
#                           over 30 s without one, or far from its weight (more than 30 s
#                           and more than double or under half, after allowing for the
#                           runner's speed), fails its job, which says the weight to write.
#   <test> run by <file>    run by <file>, which must name the test's path (not one
#                           of upstream's workflows: they are disabled in the fork)
#   ... ok lines            (after any of those, a Python test only) it prints ok lines, below;
#                           a Python test without it is a unittest test
# A test's own `fork-ci:` comment lines say more (the runner reads them):
#   fork-ci: run [as root] [with <NAME>_TESTS=value ...] [only <TestClass>[.<test_method>]]
#                           an own run, by `fork-ci-tests.cjs --run <test>` in fork-tests.yml;
#                           it may skip no test
#   fork-ci: may skip <test>
#                           its run in a part skips this test (Class.test_method, module.Class.test_method
#                           for a test of a module it loads, or an ok-lines
#                           test's skip name), one line each: it must skip exactly the named ones
#                           (fork-contracts.test.py pins them all)
# A fork test is run by fork-tests.yml (a part, or `run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml`
# for own runs); any test's other `run by` only where RUN_ELSEWHERE in fork-ci-tests.cjs names it.
# Each run leaves a record that fork-ci-result checks: a listed test with no record, or
# one that ran no test, skipped a test it does not name, or did not skip one it names, fails.
# Every test is counted by its own outcome: Python through fork-ci-unittest.py (a class or
# module skip counts each test in it, and a test its source defines that no run loaded is a
# skip by name; a unittest test that never reaches its first run or its end counts nothing),
# node through fork-ci-node-counts.cjs (a file that reports no test of its own, or stops
# half-way, counts nothing); an ok-lines test (sh, or Python with "ok lines": `ok <what>`,
# `FAIL <what>`, `skip <name> [why]` on stdout) ends with "all passed: <n> ok, <n> skipped"
# (its own count), else it counts nothing.
# A present test that is not listed fails. A listed file that is not present yet
# is a note; one that was present and then deleted fails.
.github/scripts/fork-ci-tests.test.cjs ~11s
